svg.desc: A four-node graph: a direct edge from 0 to 1 of weight 10, and a path 0-2-3-1 with three edges of weight 1. BFS takes the one-hop edge at cost 10; Dijkstra finds the three-hop path at cost 3. A heap trace shows the pops, including a stale entry skipped.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Why BFS is not enough when edges have weights

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fewest edges is not cheapest. Dijkstra expands the cheapest frontier node first.
